name: open-walnut
description: Personal AI powered by Claude — task management, Claude Code sessions, memory system, and web UI

scripts.prepublishOnly: WALNUT_REQUIRE_BUN=1 bun run build && cd web && bun x vite build && cd .. && bun scripts/check-publish.mjs
scripts.start: bun run web:build && bun dist/cli.js web --port 3456
scripts.build:plugins: bun run --filter @open-walnut/plugin-api build && bun run --filter @open-walnut/plugin-cli build
scripts.build: bun run build:plugins && bash scripts/build-daemon.sh && tsup && rm -rf dist/data && cp -r src/data dist/ && for d in src/integrations/*/manifest.json; do t="dist/integrations/$(basename $(dirname $d))"; mkdir -p "$t"; cp "$d" "$t/"; i="$(dirname $d)/icon.svg"; rm -f "$t/icon.svg"; if [ -f "$i" ]; then cp "$i" "$t/"; fi; for sub in skills agent-skills; do s="$(dirname $d)/$sub"; rm -rf "$t/$sub"; if [ -d "$s" ]; then cp -r "$s" "$t/"; fi; done; done && bun scripts/ship-builtin-plugins.mjs && bun scripts/ship-store-plugins.mjs
scripts.test:plugin-packages: bun run build:plugins && WALNUT_REQUIRE_NPM=1 bun --bun vitest run --config vitest.focus.config.ts tests/core/plugin-package-metadata.test.ts tests/core/plugin-cli-dev.test.ts tests/core/plugin-cli-scaffold.test.ts tests/core/plugin-publish-check.test.ts && bun scripts/check-plugin-packages.mjs
scripts.test:quick: bun run docs:check && bun --bun vitest run --config vitest.quick.config.ts
scripts.test:full: bun run test && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:live:daemon && bun run test:live:cloud
scripts.test:all: bun run lint && bun run lint:paths && bun run test && bun x playwright test
scripts.lint:plugins: bun run build:plugins && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/typechecks/tsconfig.plugin-api.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/plugins/walnut-demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/plugins/walnut-time/tsconfig.json
scripts.web:build: bash scripts/build-daemon.sh && tsup && rm -rf dist/data && cp -r src/data dist/ && for d in src/integrations/*/manifest.json; do t="dist/integrations/$(basename $(dirname $d))"; mkdir -p "$t"; cp "$d" "$t/"; i="$(dirname $d)/icon.svg"; rm -f "$t/icon.svg"; if [ -f "$i" ]; then cp "$i" "$t/"; fi; for sub in skills agent-skills; do s="$(dirname $d)/$sub"; rm -rf "$t/$sub"; if [ -d "$s" ]; then cp -r "$s" "$t/"; fi; done; done && bun scripts/ship-builtin-plugins.mjs && bun scripts/ship-store-plugins.mjs && cd web && ./node_modules/.bin/vite build
scripts.dev:demo: bun run web:build && (lsof -ti:3457 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null || true); (cat /tmp/open-walnut-demo/daemon.pid 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -15 2>/dev/null || true); sleep 1; echo "Demo server: http://localhost:3457  (data: $HOME/.open-walnut-demo, daemon: /tmp/open-walnut-demo; isolated from prod)"; OPEN_WALNUT_HOME="$HOME/.open-walnut-demo" WALNUT_DAEMON_DIR=/tmp/open-walnut-demo bun dist/cli.js web --port 3457
